# rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry-otel

OpenTelemetry traces backend for `rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry`. Adapts the core
`Tracer` facade onto the OTel SDK, exports OTLP, PSR-15 root-span middleware,
W3C propagation. Namespace `Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel`.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry-otel guzzlehttp/guzzle
```

Needs a PSR-18 client (guzzle) for OTLP export.

## Rules

- Installing this package binds the swappable core `TracerProviderInterface =>
  OtelTracerProvider`. Do NOT also bind it (or `Tracer`/core `TracerInterface`)
  in the app — `yiisoft/config` `Duplicate key`.
- Frozen `trace()` contract (from core): success keeps status Unset (never Ok);
  exception → recordException + status Error + end + rethrow; nested inherits
  parent traceId; `end()`/detach in `finally` (anti-leak). Flush is separate
  (`SpanFlusher`), never per request.
- Attribute keys are stable OTel semconv string literals (no sem-conv dep).
- Env: `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; sampling via
  `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER` / `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG` (default `parentbased_always_on`),
  or pass `sampler:` to `OtelTracerProviderFactory` explicitly. Kill switch:
  `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true` (params `enabled`) binds the no-op NullTracerProvider.
- Params toggles: `enabled` (default true), `batch` (true),
  `register_shutdown_flush` (true — DI registers a shutdown flush; required on
  php-fpm or batch-buffered spans are lost; disable on RR/Swoole when flushing
  via SpanFlusher on a timer), `content_type` (protobuf default; honours
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/json), `excluded_paths` ([] — exact paths
  OtelMiddleware skips, e.g. '/metrics': scrape self-traffic is trace noise),
  `capture_query` (true — url.query attr, sensitive values masked '***'),
  `capture_request_params` (false, OPT-IN — query/form/JSON-body params as
  http.request.param.<name>, masked + truncated 200 chars, bodies ≤ 8 KiB).

## API

### Provider / tracer (core-facing)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\{OtelTracerProvider, OtelTracerProviderFactory, OtlpExporterFactory};

$exporter    = (new OtlpExporterFactory())->create('http://collector:4318'); // OTLP/HTTP
$sdkProvider = (new OtelTracerProviderFactory(serviceName: 'app', batch: true))->create($exporter);
$tracer      = (new OtelTracerProvider($sdkProvider))->getTracer();           // core TracerInterface

$tracer->trace('op', static fn ($span) => $span->setAttribute('k', 'v'));
```

`OtelTracerProviderFactory::create(SpanExporterInterface)` — batch processor by
default; `batch: false` = SimpleSpanProcessor (immediate, for tests).
`OtlpExporterFactory::create(string $endpoint = 'http://localhost:4318', string $contentType = 'application/x-protobuf')`.

### Middleware (PSR-15)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\{OtelMiddleware, TraceContextExtractor};

$mw = new OtelMiddleware($tracer, new TraceContextExtractor(), $routeResolver);
// opens a SERVER span named "{method} {route}" (with a RouteNameResolverInterface
// wired; bare "{method}" otherwise — NEVER the raw path), extracts incoming
// traceparent, sets http.* attributes (incl. http.route), marks 5xx as Error,
// ends span + detaches scope in finally.

// Router-aware resolver (needs yiisoft/router; wire app-side):
//   RouteNameResolverInterface::class => CurrentRouteNameResolver::class
```

### Propagation

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\{TraceContextExtractor, TraceContextInjector};

$otelContext = (new TraceContextExtractor())->extract($serverRequest); // OTel ContextInterface (activate it)
$request     = (new TraceContextInjector())->inject($clientRequest);   // adds traceparent from active span
```

### Console commands (cron)

```php
// config/console/events.php — root span 'console <command>' around each run;
// children = DB/HTTP spans; exit code != 0 => Error. Needs yiisoft/yii-console.
ApplicationStartup::class => [[ConsoleCommandSpanListener::class, 'onStartup']],
ApplicationShutdown::class => [[ConsoleCommandSpanListener::class, 'onShutdown']],
```

### Flush (long-running)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TelemetryOtel\SpanFlusher;

$flusher = new SpanFlusher($sdkProvider); // forceFlush()
// RoadRunner/Swoole: on worker stop / a timer — never per request.
// php-fpm / CLI: no worker-shutdown hook exists; register once at bootstrap
// (runs at the END of each request — accept it, or use batch: false):
register_shutdown_function(static fn (): bool => $flusher->flush());
// No flush registered + batch processor = buffered spans LOST on fpm worker recycle.
```

### Testing

Use `OpenTelemetry\SDK\Trace\SpanExporter\InMemoryExporter` + `batch: false`, then
assert `$exporter->getSpans()[0]` fields (getName/getKind/getStatus/getAttributes/
getEvents/getResource).
